item.title: Naval warfare in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present), Ukrainian attacks on the Russian shadow fleet: A Maltese-flagged ship is also struck by naval drones off the coast of Benghazi. / Several people are killed and at least 10 people are injured after the Russian corvette Merkury is struck by a Ukrainian naval drone attack while docked at the port of Benghazi, Libya.
item.description:
Image: Al-Jazeera

A Maltese-flagged ship is also struck by naval drones off the coast of Benghazi.

Sources: Reuters

Several people are killed and at least 10 people are injured after the Russian corvette Merkury is struck by a Ukrainian naval drone attack while docked at the port of Benghazi, Libya. The Merkury reportedly capsizes and sinks.

Sources: Al-Jazeera, Reuters

item.description:
